name: fanilo-event-qr-code-scanner
description: 📱 Production QR code scanner used at Fanilo Festival in Antananarivo, Madagascar. Built with Next.js 15, Prisma, and shadcn/ui for real-time ticket validation and entry tracking.

paragraphs: A production-ready mobile QR code scanning application built for real-world event ticketing. Originally developed for the Fanilo Festival in Antananarivo, Madagascar, where it was used to manage ticket validation and entry tracking for a live event.

Real-world use case: This wasn't just a side project — it was deployed and used at an actual festival to handle real ticket scanning at the entrance, managing multiple ticket categories (1-day, 3-day, 5-day passes) with scan limits to prevent ticket sharing.
features: 📱 Mobile-First QR Scanner — Real-time QR code scanning using device camera
🔒 Secure Authentication — Role-based access control with NextAuth
📊 Live Analytics — Real-time statistics on ticket scans by category
📋 Scan History — Filterable log of all scans with date range and search
🎫 Ticket Management — Support for multiple ticket types with scan limits
